title: Machine-based and person-based UAP summoning systems

tellings.quote: There are two types of summoning that can be done that we've proven works and we're still working with.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he flew a recovered UFO out by helicopter, says there are two ways to summon UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs): one uses machines and the other uses people. He tells Michels as someone who says he takes part that "we've proven" both work and that his group is "still working with" them, which would mean these objects can be called in on purpose.
